description: Change which events an endpoint receives, rename it, or switch it off and on. This is how an endpoint comes back after we stopped sending to it: fix your server, then set enabled to true. The failure count starts again from zero. Whatever you leave out stays as it was. Needs an API key and a paid plan. Costs no credits.

anyOf.description: Your own note about this endpoint, such as which of your services it is.

enabled.description: False to stop sending here without deleting it. True to start again after we switched it off.

events.description: Which events to send here. "collection.completed" fires when a collection ends, even one that found no places; "collection.failed" fires when an error stops it. A collection you cancel sends neither.

id.description: The endpoint's id, as create_webhook returned it.

name: update_webhook
title: Change a webhook endpoint
